gen-gf-tagesschrift-fs-rowan: Glass tubing bent into letters is the look of Tagesschrift. Rowan's classic serif build, with thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones, keeps quick reading friendly and literary.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-pridi: Small letters stand proud, nearly capital-sized, with generous space where curves meet stems. Pridi is a refined serif, and Turret Road sets round, parenthesis-like forms of constant weight against it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-epunda-slab: Stout, pipe-cleaner strokes with a horseshoe-wide c: Underdog is all swagger. Epunda Slab keeps classic serif manners for steady reading, its rounded lowercase standing tall, and leaves the shouting to Underdog.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-fauna-one: Unwavering strokes and a horseshoe-open c make Underdog hard to ignore. Fauna One brings classic serif dignity, a tall middle band with shallow ascenders, while Underdog earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noticia-text: Underdog draws every curve with steady pen pressure, first letter to last. What the pair does best is pit that unbroken line against Noticia Text, a serif whose lowercase fills most of the letter height.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-piazzolla: Diagonals hit as hard as verticals, and Underdog's c gapes wide. Piazzolla, a refined serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, makes paragraphs feel authoritative and unhurried from first line to last.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-scope-one: Underdog bends each letter as if from one length of tubing. Scope One's text serif build, with counters spilling out and stubby ascenders, keeps reading sturdy beneath Underdog's tubing-like heft.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-suwannaphum: Underdog holds one line width through every letter, its c hanging open like a horseshoe. Suwannaphum, a dignified serif whose high, squared-off lowercase carries long reading with editorial steadiness.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: Wide-eyed lowercase and uniform strokes make Unica One look bold. Padyakke Expanded One, a literary serif with widely spaced glyphs and round bowls, reads best with a slightly larger size.
gen-gf-unifrakturcook-fs-rowan: UnifrakturCook packs its letters tight, with a quiet, level beat. Rowan's classic serif build is made for quick reading, and if the heading is made small or Rowan large, the order flips.
